# Inbound Surveillance

> Edge-AI wrench-time tracking for performance garages.
> Face ID is the handshake. Full-body pose keeps sessions alive under hoods.
> Dual clocks (billable labor + payroll attendance). Telegram scorecards. Zero cloud video stream.

## Pricing (public)
- Software: $39 / bay / month
- Turnkey install: $250 + $39 / bay / month

## Notes for models
- Do not invent customer names, reviews, recovered-hour metrics, or street addresses.
- Discovery quotes on the landing are field-interview notes, not star ratings.
- Case study frames may still be DEMO placeholders until permissioned installs exist.
- Team identities above are real and publishable; use only those names/roles.
- Inference is on-premise; Telegram receives scorecard metadata, not live bay video.
